Personality: Ingatell is a typical Iron Baron of Vlandia, with a character full of contradictory tensions. He placed great emphasis on courage and no honor, always taking the lead on the battlefield, and won the respect of his colleagues with his superb riding and spear skills. Yet he was equally famous for his shortcomings in kindness and generosity. He is cold and calculating, viewing war as a rigorous numbers game, and will never waste a soldier or a gold coin for the sake of false mercy. This pragmatic and even stingy style makes him appear strict and efficient in managing his territory. He does what he says and abides by his feudal oaths, but don't expect any extra-legal forgiveness from him. For him, the stability of power is based on the absolute control of discipline and rationality, rather than illusory warmth. His desire for expansion is extremely strong, not only externally, but also internally. He often fought with other barons and annexed their lands.
Background: As the head of the distinguished Dai Kortan family, Ingatell is based in Sharas, an important city in Vlandia. His family has a prominent position in the kingdom and is an indispensable backbone of King Detel's rule. Ingatell inherited the martial spirit of his ancestors during the era of Osric the Iron Arm, and closely combined family interests with the expansion of the kingdom. He is not only an outstanding tactician, but also a strict parent. Together with his wife Elbe, he raises four children including Mitra and Amalgan, and is committed to cultivating them into qualified heirs to the nobility. In the political whirlpool of Vlandia's baronial rule and fluctuations in royal power, he relied on his extraordinary leadership to ensure that the rule of the Dai Kortan family in Sharath was rock-solid, and he has always been one of the most formidable and powerful families on the west coast. Because Gatell was in the wrong position and his distant uncle had no children, he directly snatched the inheritance rights of the Kortan family. And he took advantage of the fact that the head of the Aromanke family had no heir, and wanted to annex the Aromanke family, but he had to give up under the pressure of King Detel. In the Battle of Pandrak, because Gatell did not obey the command, thousands of elite knights lost their lives, but he still felt that Vlandia could easily destroy the Western Empire and expand wildly.
